user.title: Battery Optimizer
user.description: Configure data sources and battery parameters.

data.price_source: Price data source (emaldo = Emaldo internal, sensor = external sensor)
data.spot_price_sensor: Nordpool spot price sensor (only when source is 'sensor')
data.battery_wear_cost: Battery wear cost (per kWh cycled, e.g. 0.03 = 3 cents/kWh)
data.enable_soc_safeguard: SoC floor safeguard — keep-alive charging at the cheapest slots so idle drain never pulls SoC below Min SoC
data.soc_recovery_buffer_pct: SoC recovery buffer (%) — keep-alive charge target = Min SoC + buffer (default 5)
data.idle_strategy: Idle slot strategy (full_control = override all idle slots; solar_guard = override idle only before solar; smart_override = override only when internal AI plans charge before solar)
data.soc_guard_interval: SoC guard update interval in minutes (0 = disabled, 15/30/60/120). Actively adjusts the discharge floor to prevent faster-than-planned discharge.
data.optimizer_interval: Optimizer re-run interval in minutes (15/30/60/120). How often the optimizer recalculates the schedule.
data.auto_base_load: Auto-tune base load from history (uses household load power sensor)
data.load_energy_sensor: Household load power sensor (W) for auto base load (e.g. sensor.emhass_combined_power)
data.enable_pv_strategy: Enable PV sell strategy (sell solar to grid during high-price slots instead of charging battery)
data.solar_sell_min_forecast_kwh: Min Solcast forecast to activate PV sell strategy (kWh, default 10 — skip on cloudy days)
data.solar_forecast_mode: Solar forecast mode for charge planning (p10 = pessimistic/weather-aware, p50 = median/optimistic)
data.solar_forecast_scale: Solar forecast scale (0 = auto-tune from accuracy history; 0.8 scales the forecast down 20%)

error.sensor_not_found: One or more configured sensors not found.

data.price_source: Price data source (emaldo = Emaldo internal, sensor = external sensor)

data.load_energy_sensor: Household load power sensor (W, for auto base load)
